payload.reason: The evidence describes how the model incorporates wind effects on snowpack through the snowfall factor, which adjusts snowfall to account for wind-induced snow ablation and redistribution.

claims.text: The model uses a snowfall factor to represent the effects of wind-induced snow redistribution, reducing incoming snowfall to capture snow ablation due to wind drift.
The snowfall factor is set to 0.25, indicating a 75% reduction in snowfall to account for the effects of wind on snowpack.
The model captures the effects of wind on ground temperatures phenomenologically by adjusting the snowfall factor based on areas of net snow ablation or deposition.
